'''''Redemption''''', also known as '''''Portrait of Master Kenobi''''', was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] kneeling before the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. A field of [[Star/Legends|stars]] appears in the background of Master Kenobi while a cloudy yet sunny sky appears behind the Padawan.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Redemption'' was a painting available to players in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Added to the game as part of the ''Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild'' update on [[May 22]], [[2007]], the painting was automatically granted to all players who logged on after the release of the update. It could be used as decoration in the player character's house. A second version of this painting, named ''Portrait of Master Kenobi'', existed in the game; this version had a silver frame and was only available on the Japanese servers of ''Star Wars Galaxies''.<ref name="SWG" />
